name: actvox
description: Connect Cursor to an ActVox workspace. Read and update shared pages, tables, comments, and tasks with the permissions on your workspace API key.

ACTVOX_API_KEY.title: ActVox API key
ACTVOX_API_KEY.description: Workspace API key from ActVox Connectors → API keys. It must be bound to one workspace. Cursor sends it as the MCP Bearer token. Do not paste the key into chat.
